outcome_summary: Implemented changelog-derived versioning across both the @mistralys/persona-builder library (v2.6.0) and the ai-insights personas consumer: a new resolveChangelogMeta() utility, engine-level wiring into buildContext() and buildAgentNameMap(), build-script adaptation with {{#if last_updated}} guards, YAML cleanup removing explicit version/last_updated from all 37 persona files, and full documentation + Persona Curator template updates. All 6 work packages completed with 483 passing tests and 111 personas building cleanly with zero coexistence warnings. One HIGH-priority deferred item remains: personas/package.json uses a local file: path for @mistralys/persona-builder that must be replaced with the published ^2.6.0 semver range before any portable release.
